segments.title: What's the BIGGEST desert on Earth?
segments.say: What's the biggest desert on Earth? Sahara, Gobi, or Antarctica? Lock it in. Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It's Antarctica!
segments.say: It's Antarctica! Yes, the icy one.

segments.title: Desert = very little rain
segments.sub: It's about rain and snow, **not heat**
segments.say: A desert is about how little rain or snow falls, not how hot it is.

segments.title: About 14 million km²
segments.say: Britannica lists the Antarctic ice sheet at about fourteen million square kilometers.
